prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic cinematic morning bedroom selfie of an approved adult woman.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with fair skin, long slightly messy blonde hair, natural freckles, relaxed just-woke-up expression, soft neutral lips, minimal makeup, and calm morning gaze, wearing an opaque white fitted ribbed short-sleeve top with only generic minimal print.
prompt.composition_elements: Close chest-and-face selfie from arm's length while leaning comfortably on a bed, shoulders slightly angled, soft white sheets, sheer curtains, morning sunlight and clean calm bedroom.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused side-window morning light, gentle highlights and smooth shadows, warm daylight tones, cinematic softness and realistic pores.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 50mm portrait-lens look, shallow depth, sharp eyes and skin, 8K-style detail, natural fabric and hair texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: An ultra-realistic cinematic morning selfie of an approved adult woman with fair skin, long slightly messy blonde hair, natural freckles, minimal makeup, and a relaxed just-woke-up expression with a calm neutral gaze. She wears an opaque white fitted ribbed short-sleeve top with only a generic minimal print and leans comfortably on a bed while holding the camera at arm's length. Frame chest and face, with shoulders slightly angled, soft white sheets, sheer curtains, and warm morning sunlight through a side window. Use a 50mm portrait-lens look, shallow depth, sharp eyes, natural pores, realistic fabric and hair, gentle highlights, smooth shadows, and cinematic daylight softness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, lingerie, exposed chest, sexualized morning gaze, nudity, over-smooth skin, plastic skin, waxy, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text, logo, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required environment reference. No typography or logo is required.

changes: Clarified approved adult and replaced exposed/sexualized morning wording with opaque short-sleeve coverage and a calm neutral expression.
